summary: Camden Property Trust filed an 8-K to disclose entry into new at-the-market (ATM) equity sale agreements, replacing expiring ones. The agreements allow the company to sell up to $500 million of common shares through managers and forward purchasers via primary sales and forward hedge sales. No specific price per share, premium, or board recommendation is provided, as this is a routine shelf takedown program, not a special situation. The filing is a standard capital markets activity, not an acquisition, divestiture, or other event-driven category. What to watch: actual issuance pace and market reception.
